Charles Brockden Brown, Wieland.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/charles-brockden-brown/wieland

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Charles Brockden Brown, the annotator, the author, the writer of a preface, died 1810 (Wikidata Q468280, P570 = 1810-02-22).

First publication of the text used: 1798 (SE colophon: 'Wieland was published in 1798 by Charles Brockden Brown.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1798, before 1931. A work first published in the United States before 1931 is in the United States public domain (rights statement below).
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published there in 1798 (Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wieland_(novel), country: United States). The United States rule settles its origin, whatever the death year of any person named above.
